decisions.reason: As a highlighted multi-model electric infrared panel heater line, it remains well aligned with the firm's low-carbon building-climate strategy and benefits from the shift away from less attractive electric infrared variants already discontinued.

This industrial electric infrared hall heater line stays close to the firm's core applications in large non-residential spaces and should continue to sell as an efficient electrified option for halls and workshops.

The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater still fits the firm's strategic direction and innovation profile, although rollout risk is somewhat higher than for the electric lines because hydrogen adoption in customer sites can be slower and more uncertain.
